claim_1.claim: Flow cytometry AIM analysis of PBMCs from 10 recovered COVID-19 patients and 11 SARS-CoV-2-unexposed donors, using stimulation with a SARS-CoV-2 spike megapool, showed that SARS-CoV-2 spike-specific CD4+ T cell responses were detected in 100% of COVID-19 cases when comparing recovered COVID-19 patients versus unexposed donors.

sources.quote: SARS-CoV-2 spike-specific CD4+ T cell responses (OX40+CD137+) were detected in 100% of COVID-19 cases (p < 0.0001 versus unexposed donors spike MP, Figures 2A and 2B.  p = 0.002 versus DMSO control, Figure 2C).

comparison.finding: SARS-CoV-2 spike-specific CD4+ T cell responses were detected in 100% of COVID-19 cases
CD4+ T cell responses to the remainder of the SARS-CoV-2 orfeome were detected in 100% of COVID-19 cases

claim_2: ELISA analysis of plasma from convalescent COVID-19 patients showed that all COVID-19 cases were IgG positive, and anti-RBD IgM and IgA were also detected in the large majority of cases.

sources.quote: All cases were IgG positive; anti-RBD IgM and IgA was also detected in the large majority of cases.

comparison.finding: All COVID-19 cases were IgG positive, and anti-RBD IgM and IgA were detected in the large majority of cases

claim_3.claim: Flow cytometry ICS analysis using intracellular cytokine staining of PBMCs from recovered COVID-19 patients and SARS-CoV-2-unexposed donors showed that IFNγ+ SARS-CoV-2-specific CD8+ T cells were detected in the majority of COVID-19 cases, with most IFNγ+ cells co-expressing granzyme B and a substantial fraction expressing TNF but not IL-10.

sources.quote: Independently, ICS assays detected IFNγ+ SARS-CoV-2−specific CD8+ T cells in the majority of COVID-19 cases (Fig. 3C-D). The majority of IFNγ+ cells co-expressed granzyme B (Fig. 3D-E). A substantial fraction of the IFNγ+ cells expressed TNF, but not IL-10 (Fig. 3D).

comparison.finding: IFNγ+ SARS-CoV-2-specific CD8+ T cells were detected in the majority of COVID-19 cases; most IFNγ+ cells co-expressed granzyme B, and a substantial fraction expressed TNF but not IL-10
